verdict.rationale: LangSmith ships official SDKs across Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java, with GitHub-hosted client library (langsmith-sdk) and concrete code examples like wrap_openai; docs explicitly point developers to these SDKs for tracing/integration work across any agent stack. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews confirming SDK quality/completeness, and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s) that would round out programmatic/API-native access.
